ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious UltraVNC Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious UltraVNC command line flag combination that indicate a auto reconnect upon execution, e.g. startup (as seen being used by Gamaredon threat group)

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-autoreconnect\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-connect\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-id\\:.*"))
